subject: Transportation Systems
title: Satellite Internet for Transport
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Satellite Internet for Transport.

hook.text: Starlink and its rivals are putting thousands of satellites into orbit. Connected transport is one key use.

buildup.text: Satellite internet gives ships, aircraft, and vehicles connectivity anywhere on Earth—even mid-ocean.

discovery.text: Connected planes offer fast WiFi at 35,000 feet. Ships track cargo and conditions in real time.

twist.text: Autonomous vehicles in remote areas could use satellite links where cell towers don't reach.

climax.text: Ubiquitous connectivity is making every vehicle a data node in a global transportation network.

punchline.text: Satellites don't move people—but they move the data that does.

quiz.question: How does satellite internet benefit transportation?
options: It provides connectivity for vehicles anywhere on Earth, enabling real-time tracking
